summary: The article accurately reports on PhonePe's new inactivity fee, its conditions, and ways to avoid it, aligning with recent news and PhonePe's stated policy. It also correctly references similar practices by other fintech companies and RBI guidelines.

claims.claim: PhonePe has introduced a ₹100 quarterly inactivity fee for wallets that have not recorded any financial transaction for 365 consecutive days.
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm PhonePe's introduction of a ₹100 quarterly inactivity fee for wallets inactive for 365 days.

claims.claim: This fee will be deducted directly from the existing wallet balance, though the balance will not go into negative territory.
claims.note: Sources confirm the fee is deducted from the wallet balance and will not result in a negative balance.

claims.claim: Merely logging into the app or performing UPI transactions will not count as wallet activity to reset the inactivity clock.
claims.note: PhonePe has clarified that only wallet-based financial transactions count as activity; UPI transactions or logging in do not.

claims.claim: Users will receive a 15-day notice before the fee is deducted, providing an opportunity to reactivate the wallet.
claims.note: PhonePe will provide a 15-day notice period before deducting the fee.

claims.claim: The PhonePe inactivity fee is applicable from June 2026.
claims.note: Multiple news articles published in June 2026 confirm the fee's applicability from June 2026.

claims.claim: Other platforms like MobiKwik and Airtel Payments Bank have also implemented similar inactivity or maintenance charges for dormant wallets in the past.
claims.note: MobiKwik and Airtel Payments Bank have indeed implemented similar charges.

claims.claim: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) also has guidelines for Prepaid Payment Instruments (PPIs) regarding disclosure of charges, expiry, closure, and refunds, which PPI issuers must adhere to.
claims.note: The RBI's Master Direction on Prepaid Payment Instruments (PPIs) includes guidelines on disclosure of charges, expiry, closure, and refunds.

article_title: PhonePe Inactivity Fee: Avoid the ₹100 Quarterly Charge
